records.evidence_slice: RBKC's official Community Safety Consultation report (May 2021) provides ward-level postcode analysis. Campden has four postcode-linked respondents. For feeling safe during the day, Campden records 2 Agree, 2 Disagree and 0 Neither; for feeling safe at night, Campden records 2 Agree, 2 Disagree and 0 Neither. The report context makes clear that ward breakdowns are based on small respondent counts. This batch records that official ward-level source-area evidence only and does not claim parcel geometry, spatial join or programme progress.
